name: read
description: Read part of the map as an indented, id-tagged outline: one line per node with [id], kind, status, source count and confidence. Use it to see a branch before adding to it or reorganising it. Defaults to the whole map from the root, 3 levels deep, without bodies. Large results are paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor. Read-only.

node_id.description: Start here instead of the root. Node id (nd_...) or an @ref you set earlier in this run.

depth.description: Levels below the start node. Default 3.

include_bodies.description: Include markdown bodies and sources. Default false; turn on only for small branches.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous read, to get the next page.

map_id.description: Read another map in the same workspace (read-only). Omit for your own map.
